name: workflow-intake
description: Turn an external gist, README, issue, or runbook into a pinned comparison and safe local test plan.

interface.shortDescription: Adapt external procedures with pinned evidence.
interface.longDescription: Pins an external procedure, compares its assumptions with the current system, and produces an exact, adapted, or rejected execution plan with rollback and verification gates.
defaultPrompt: Compare this gist with what we are running and prepare a safe test.
Pin this runbook and classify which steps can be reused as written.
Adapt this external procedure to the current repository conventions.
